_comment: Operator inbox of match -> YouTube URL pairs. Add a row, then run python scripts/process_match_videos.py. The processed store is data/external/match_videos.json (the frontend never reads this file). A string value is the URL; an object may add offset / anchor / force_identity / notes. The object key is the channel label and, when it matches the match roster, the cockpit (--pov). Removing a row does not delete a store entry.

Nomad.notes: sparse OCR missed the small upper-right Mission Time; clocks read from frames at a constant +33s. identity gate 3/8 need 4 (Darkvale, darkvale, Good Luck Happy Die)
